sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is now officially against passing the funding bill that would avoid a government shutdown four days before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 在圣诞节前四天，唐纳德·特朗普现在正式反对通过旨在避免政府关门的拨款法案。

sentences.en: Weeks before his inauguration,
sentences.zh: 在他就职数周前，

sentences.en: President-elect Trump is pushing the federal government toward a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 候任总统特朗普正将联邦政府推向关门边缘。

sentences.en: Look at the list of CEOs who are either shelling out big money or meeting with Trump in person or both.
sentences.zh: 看看这份首席执行官名单，他们要么掏出巨资，要么亲自与特朗普会面，或者两者兼有。

sentences.en: We're talking about CEOs from TikTok, Google, Apple, Netflix.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是来自TikTok、谷歌、苹果、奈飞的首席执行官。

sentences.en: The country's corporate titans are flocking to Mar-a-Lago to curry Trump's favor.
sentences.zh: 国家的企业巨头们正蜂拥至海湖庄园以博取特朗普的欢心。

sentences.en: Today, ABC News agreed to give $15 million to Donald Trump's president.
sentences.zh: 今天，美国广播公司新闻同意向唐纳德·特朗普的总统身份支付1500万美元。

sentences.en: And a major media company has capitulated to Trump's legal strategy of suing those who cross it.
sentences.zh: 一家大型媒体公司向特朗普起诉反对者的法律战略妥协了。

sentences.en: To make sense of all of this, I gathered three of my colleagues, senior political correspondent Maggie Haberman, congressional reporter Katie Edmondson,
sentences.zh: 为了理清这一切，我召集了我的三位同事：资深政治记者玛吉·哈伯曼、国会记者凯蒂·埃德蒙森，

sentences.en: and financial columnist and the founder of DealBook,
sentences.zh: 以及金融专栏作家、“交易书”创始人，

sentences.en: Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: It's Friday, December 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月20日，星期五。

sentences.en: Everyone, welcome to the roundtable.
sentences.zh: 各位，欢迎来到圆桌会议。

sentences.en: Katie, Maggie, Andrew, thank you all for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂、玛吉、安德鲁，谢谢你们百忙之中抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Okay, let's jump right in.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们直接切入正题。

sentences.en: We are talking to the three of you at a very live news moment,
sentences.zh: 我们在一个非常动态的新闻时刻与你们三位对话，
中午12点33分，

sentences.en: on Thursday, with a government shutdown looming.
sentences.zh: 周四，政府面临关门危机。

sentences.en: And I mentioned that timing because events could change after we tape.
sentences.zh: 我提到这个时间是因为在我们录制之后情况可能会发生变化。

sentences.en: There could, for example, be a deal to try to avert a shutdown.
sentences.zh: 例如，可能会达成一项试图避免关门的协议。

sentences.en: But I think shutdown is where we need to start this conversation.
sentences.zh: 但我认为关门是我们这次对话的切入点。

sentences.en: And unlike many of the threatened partial or full government shutdowns that have happened over the past couple of years, this one kind of came out of nowhere, right?
sentences.zh: 与过去几年发生的许多受到威胁的部分或全部政府关门不同，这次似乎凭空出现，对吧？

sentences.en: Does that feel like an accurate statement?
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一个准确的陈述吗？

sentences.en: Who here wants to jump in?
sentences.zh: 这里谁想先说？

sentences.en: Katie?
sentences.zh: 凯蒂？

sentences.en: I can pick it up because I've been through many of these spending fights now, and the last few of them have been fairly anticlimactic.
sentences.zh: 我来接话，因为我经历过许多这样的支出争夺战，而且过去几次都相当反高潮。

sentences.en: They've made it through the Senate to President Biden's desk, really without much drama.
sentences.zh: 它们顺利通过参议院来到拜登总统的办公桌上，几乎没有什么戏剧性。

sentences.en: And I think we generally had an idea that that was going to happen again this time.
sentences.zh: 我想我们普遍认为这次也会这样。

sentences.en: And, of course, that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 当然，事情并非如此。

sentences.en: Instead, when Mike Johnson, the Speaker of the House, unveiled the spending bill that he negotiated with Democrats, it included a litany of other measures,
sentences.zh: 相反，当众议院议长迈克·约翰逊公布他与民主党人谈判达成的拨款法案时，其中包含了一长串其他措施，

sentences.en: including $100 billion in disaster aid for the American SoutheaSt.
sentences.zh: 包括向美国东南部提供1000亿美元的灾害援助。

sentences.en: But it also had all of these other provisions that were added to it.
sentences.zh: 但它也附加了所有这些其他条款。

sentences.en: And so when this bill was unveiled, there was a wide swath of Republicans in the House who were furious with it.
sentences.zh: 因此，当这个法案公布时，众议院的一大批共和党人对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And then, of course, we had Elon Musk weigh in, and that really began sort of the final death rattle for this bill.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，我们有了埃隆·马斯克的介入，这真正拉开了该法案最终走向死亡的序幕。

sentences.en: Andrew, pick up where Katie leaves off Elon Musk, not traditionally a participant in congressional spending bill negotiations.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，接着凯蒂的话说。埃隆·马斯克，传统上并不是国会拨款法案谈判的参与者。

sentences.en: Why is he involved, and what exactly does he do?
sentences.zh: 他为什么参与进来，他又究竟做了什么？

sentences.en: This, to me, is the beginning of the movie that we've all been waiting to see and wonder how the drama plays out, which is to say that we've all seen Elon Musk around the table
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是我们一直在等待并且想知道戏剧性如何展开的那部电影的开场，也就是说，我们都看到埃隆·马斯克和候任总统特朗普

sentences.en: with President-elect Trump.
sentences.zh: 坐在一起。

sentences.en: Literally.
sentences.zh: 字面意思。

sentences.en: But we haven't really known, in fact, I think a lot of people have been skeptical about just how much power he may or may not have.
sentences.zh: 但我们并不真的知道，事实上，我认为很多人一直对他的权力到底有多大持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Well, he used it, and we saw it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他动用了权力，我们都看到了。

sentences.en: Just describe what he did and what it ends up doing, and then Maggie will get to how Trump responds to that.
sentences.zh: 请描述一下他做了什么以及最终导致了什么，然后玛吉会谈谈特朗普对此如何反应。

sentences.en: He took to Twitter, or I should say X, and said this bill should not pass.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上，或者我应该说X上说，这个法案不应该通过。

sentences.en: Full stop.
sentences.zh: 句号。

sentences.en: His partner in Doge, the Department of Government Efficiency, Vivek Ramaswamy, also took to Twitter and to TikTok after having read 1,500-plus pages of the bill
sentences.zh: 他在政府效率部（Doge）的伙伴维韦克·拉马斯瓦米在阅读了1500多页的法案后，也在推特和TikTok上发声，

sentences.en: and said this bill should not pass.
sentences.zh: 称这个法案不应该通过。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: For the reasons Katie suggested that suddenly it's larded up with stuff?
sentences.zh: 是因为凯蒂暗示的原因，即它突然被塞满了各种东西？

sentences.en: Because of exactly how much it was larded up with stuff, specifically pointing out that Congress was effectively giving itself a pay raise for the first time in 14 years,
sentences.zh: 正是因为里面塞了太多东西，特别是指出国会实际上在14年来首次给自己加薪，

sentences.en: there was what they call pork in this bill.
sentences.zh: 这个法案里有所谓的夹带私货。

sentences.en: And Elon Musk said, no, Moss, we're not doing this.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克说，不，莫斯，我们不这么做。

sentences.en: And Trump said, we're not doing this.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，我们不这么做。

sentences.en: Maggie, who's leading who by the nose here?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，到底是谁在牵着谁的鼻子走？

sentences.en: I mean, Elon Musk does all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，埃隆·马斯克做了所有这些事。

sentences.en: What does the president-elect do?
sentences.zh: 候任总统做了什么？

sentences.en: Donald Trump does not need goosing or juicing to be against this particular bill, at least publicly.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普不需要别人怂恿或刺激去反对这个特定的法案，至少在公开场合是这样。

sentences.en: The question is not which one of them got the other riled up.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于他们俩是谁激怒了谁。

sentences.en: They clearly got each other riled up.
sentences.zh: 他们显然互相把对方激怒了。

sentences.en: The question is, what did Trump actually know about what was in this bill before this all started?
sentences.zh: 问题是，在这一切开始之前，特朗普对这个法案里到底有什么内容究竟了解多少？

sentences.en: There are things in this bill that he wasn't going to like, and that I think should have been pretty clear to Mike Johnson.
sentences.zh: 这个法案里有些东西是他不会喜欢的，而且我认为迈克·约翰逊本应该对此非常清楚。

sentences.en: So Elon Musk and Donald Trump were going to, I think, both arrive at this place pretty naturally.
sentences.zh: 所以我想埃隆·马斯克和唐纳德·特朗普都会很自然地走到这一步。

sentences.en: This is not one following the other.
sentences.zh: 这不是谁模仿谁。

sentences.en: And now Trump is very dramatically taking the lead and gave a bunch of interviews to television reporters on Thursday morning
sentences.zh: 现在特朗普非常戏剧性地占据了主导地位，并在周四上午接受了电视记者的多场采访，

sentences.en: saying various versions of why this bill shouldn't exist and why maybe Mike Johnson shouldn't be the speaker if he can't push through what Trump wants.
sentences.zh: 以各种方式表达了为什么这个法案不该存在，以及如果迈克·约翰逊无法强推特朗普想要的东西，他或许就不该担任议长。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So Katie, once Trump publicly agrees with Elon Musk, this is a bad bill.
sentences.zh: 那么凯蒂，一旦特朗普公开同意埃隆·马斯克的观点，即这是一个糟糕的法案。

sentences.en: It should be blown up.
sentences.zh: 它应该被彻底推翻。

sentences.en: Go back to the drawing board.
sentences.zh: 重新回到绘图板前制定新方案。

sentences.en: What actually happens in the House that brings us to this point where it seems like we might actually have a government shutdown as of tonight at midnight or so?
sentences.zh: 众议院实际发生了什么，才让我们走到了这一步——似乎我们今天午夜左右真的要面临政府关门了？

sentences.en: Well, I think it was pretty clear that this particular piece of legislation was on life support once Elon started tweeting, frankly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为很明显，一旦埃隆开始发推特，这部特定的立法就等于在靠呼吸机维持生命了，坦白说。

sentences.en: We heard from Republicans who were whipping votes on this that they knew that they were hemorrhaging votes every time Elon tweeted.
sentences.zh: 我们从负责拉票的共和党人那里听到，他们知道每次埃隆发推特，他们都在失去选票。

sentences.en: So when Trump weighs in, it basically pushes this bill that was sort of on the edge, just over the cliff.
sentences.zh: 所以当特朗普介入时，它基本上把这个本就处于边缘的法案直接推下了悬崖。

sentences.en: And Republicans realized that that is not going to be a viable option.
sentences.zh: 共和党人意识到这不会是一个可行的选项。

sentences.en: And Speaker Johnson is trying to figure out what is a package they can put forward that has the votes to pass that is going to be able to placate these, you know,
sentences.zh: 约翰逊议长正试图弄清楚，他们可以提出一个什么样的方案，既能获得通过所需的选票，又能安抚这些，你知道的，

sentences.en: widely divergent factions within his conference that we've talked so much about.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过的好斗且严重分歧的党内派系。

sentences.en: And a real problem for him is that Trump added another stipulation, which is he said, also, I need Republicans in this funding package
sentences.zh: 对他来说一个真正的问题是，特朗普增加了一个新条件，那就是他说，同样地，我需要这份拨款方案中的共和党人

sentences.en: to lift the debt ceiling, to suspend the debt ceiling, because that is a fight I do not want to have on my watch.
sentences.zh: 提高债务上限，暂停债务上限，因为这是我不想在我的任期内经历的争斗。

sentences.en: He actually says in his statement something to the effect of raising the debt ceiling is never great, but if we're going to do it, let's do it on Biden's watch.
sentences.zh: 他在声明中实际上说的大意是，提高债务上限从来都不是件好事，但如果要这么做，那就趁拜登的任期做吧。

sentences.en: Explicitly.
sentences.zh: 明确指出了这一点。

sentences.en: So suddenly, on top of blowing up a bill that he and Elon Musk think are inconsistent with his efforts to make government smaller,
sentences.zh: 因此，突然之间，除了推翻一个他和埃隆·马斯克认为与其精简政府努力相悖的法案之外，

sentences.en: he's suddenly now asking Congress to increase the debt ceiling, which is not very Republican and not very government efficient, right, Andrew?
sentences.zh: 他现在突然要求国会提高债务上限，这既不太符合共和党风格，也不太符合政府效率，对吧，安德鲁？

sentences.en: And do it not on his watch, because it's not consistent with what he thinks of as his self-image, but on the current president's watch.
sentences.zh: 而且不要在他的任期内做，因为这与他自认为的形象不符，而是要在现任总统的任期内做。

sentences.en: But Katie, Republicans hate voting for raising the debt ceiling, and Dems aren't going to give them a win right now, I suspect, because they don't want to give Donald Trump a win.
sentences.zh: 但凯蒂，共和党人讨厌投票赞成提高债务上限，而民主党人现在肯定不会给他们送分，因为他们不想给唐纳德·特朗普送分。

sentences.en: Does that equal deadlock and therefore shutdown?
sentences.zh: 这是否等于陷入僵局并因此导致关门？

sentences.en: Well, this is where the math gets really complicated, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是数学变得非常复杂的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: As you pointed out, there are a number of Republicans who have said they do not want to vote for a debt ceiling increase at all.
sentences.zh: 正如你所指出的，许多共和党人已经表示他们根本不想投票支持提高债务上限。

sentences.en: There are a number of Republicans who have said that they'll vote for a debt ceiling increase, but only if it's paired with, you know, sweeping spending cuts,
sentences.zh: 许多共和党人表示，他们会投票支持提高债务上限，但前提是必须伴随大范围的开支削减，

sentences.en: which again is not going to happen on the watch of a Democratic-controlled Senate and White House.
sentences.zh: 而这在民主党控制的参议院和白宫任期内是绝对不会发生的。

sentences.en: And so then it does become a question of, is there a block of those ultra-conservative Republicans who are willing to walk the plank
sentences.zh: 所以这就变成了一个问题：是否有一批极保守派共和党人愿意冒险跨过悬崖，

sentences.en: because it is what President-elect Trump has demanded?
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为这是候任总统特朗普的要求？

sentences.en: And I think it's also an open question, is there a small group of Democrats, maybe particularly those in tough districts who just went through a bruising re-election,
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是一个未决问题：是否存在一小群民主党人，也许特别是那些刚刚经历过惨烈连任选战、身处艰难选区的民主党人，

sentences.en: who maybe want to show off their bipartisan bona fides by saying, you know, I will work with Republicans to avert a shutdown before the holidays.
sentences.zh: 他们可能想通过说“你知道的，我将与共和党人合作在假期前避免政府关门”来展示他们的两党合作资历？

sentences.en: I don't know what the answer is yet.
sentences.zh: 我还不知道答案是什么。

sentences.en: We still have to figure that out.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然需要弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: To the degree that we think this is Elon Musk's first real exercise of raw power, even if Trump might have eventually gotten there, are we now witnessing the risk
sentences.zh: 从我们认为这是埃隆·马斯克第一次真正行使纯粹权力的程度来看——即使特朗普最终也可能走到这一步——我们现在是否正在目睹

sentences.en: of empowering whimsical billionaires in the way that Trump is starting to do?
sentences.zh: 赋权那些异想天开的亿万富翁所带来的风险，就像特朗普开始做的那样？

sentences.en: So Rand Paul this morning suggested that Elon Musk should become the Speaker of the House.
sentences.zh: 所以兰·保罗今天上午建议埃隆·马斯克应该成为众议院议长。

sentences.en: You laugh, but I think to some extent he was serious with that suggestion.
sentences.zh: 你笑了，但我认为他在某种程度上是认真提出这个建议的。

sentences.en: By the way, you don't apparently have to be elected to that role, interestingly enough.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，有趣的是，担任这个角色显然不需要通过选举产生。

sentences.en: So to the Elon Musk piece of it, real quick,
sentences.zh: 所以回到埃隆·马斯克的部分，简单来说，

sentences.en: you know, I do think this was the first demonstration of his quote-unquote power in a true political sense in that for a very long time, he has made lots of proclamations on X,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的确认为这是他在真正的政治意义上对所谓权力的第一次展示，因为在很长一段时间里，他在X上发表了大量声明，

sentences.en: but has mostly been screaming into the wind.
sentences.zh: 但大多只是对着空气呐喊。

sentences.en: But now he clearly has the ear of the president-elect.
sentences.zh: 但现在他显然成了候任总统的红人。

sentences.en: But more importantly,
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，

sentences.en: he's able to take that and the power of being able to galvanize this entire community behind him, I think changes the dynamic.
sentences.zh: 他能够利用这一点以及能够号召整个社区支持他的力量，我认为这改变了动态。

sentences.en: And so I do think this is sort of that first demonstration.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为这是那次首次展示。

sentences.en: What that really means,
sentences.zh: 这究竟意味着什么，

sentences.en: I don't think we really know.
sentences.zh: 我想我们并不是真的很清楚。

sentences.en: But, you know, we've all talked about, you know, will he be able to do things?
